notes: Views and indexes contain no authoritative rows and are rebuilt separately.
Only fields listed above may change. Unknown or new tables are preserved automatically.
Historical views, analytics, counters without a complete source ledger, audit history, consents and delivery/idempotency records are preserved.
Reference data preserves production IDs and edits; it is not blindly reseeded.
No production reset or cutover is authorized by this policy. Rebuilds create a new local candidate file.
